messages:
support_jordan: FYI customer `acme-app` opened a support ticket — their p99 for /v1/generate jumped to ~22s around 09:10 PST. Only mobile clients affected per them. No 5xx, responses eventually 200 but huge tail. Can we triage?
eng-sre-oncall: Looking at infra dashboard now — global p95 ~300ms but p99 spikes on a handful of serving pods. Correlates with increased continuous-batcher hold_time on pool `prod-gpu-a`.
monitoring-bot: alert: continuous-batcher.p99_ms > 15000 on prod-gpu-a (09:09 — 09:14 PST) — burst of ~3k tiny requests/minute from client_id=acme-mobile-prod.
alex.k: Quick theory: small-prompt heavy traffic -> batcher waiting to fill batch -> occasional long waits when burst pattern mismatches batching window. Also saw a recent rollout that bumped tiny_request_threshold to 32 and hold_window_ms to 80ms for that pool (canary tag `cb-v2-heuristic`).
samira: Can you paste the config diff? If hold window is 80ms and tiny threshold is very low, that can magnify tail for low-concurrency pods.
eng-sre-oncall: config snippet from runtime:
```
continuous_batcher:
  tiny_request_threshold: 32
  hold_window_ms: 80
  max_batch_size: 64
  coalescer_jitter_ms: 20
```
eng-sre-oncall: Repro steps I used locally (simulates mobile traffic):
```
for i in {1..2000}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROD_KEY" \
    -H "X-Client-Id: acme-mobile-prod" \
    -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}' &
done
```
loadbot: Observed that when concurrency per pod drops to ~4 active inflight requests, the batching window waits full 80ms trying to reach size, but traffic is bursty so some requests see >15s end-to-end due to queueing and retry backoff from client.
maya_r: Immediate mitigation suggestion: reduce hold_window_ms to 8ms and bump tiny_request_threshold to 96 for prod-gpu-a pool. That favors immediate dispatch for tiny prompts and uses prefix cache + batching across more pods. Also reduce coalescer_jitter_ms to 6ms.
alex.k: Agreed. Steps: 1) Patch canary config on 10% of prod-gpu-a hosts with new values, 2) observe p99 for 30m, 3) if good, roll to 50% then 100%. I'll prepare CLI commands.
eng-sre-oncall: CLI patch (canary apply):
```
runtimectl update-pool prod-gpu-a \
  --set continuous_batcher.hold_window_ms=8 \
  --set continuous_batcher.tiny_request_threshold=96 \
  --set continuous_batcher.coalescer_jitter_ms=6 \
  --canary 0.1
```
eng-sre-oncall: Also enabling extra tracing for these pods to capture per-request hold_ms and batch_size in traces: feature flag `cb-debug-traces=true` for canary nodes.
support_jordan: Customer on the ticket needs an ETA for mitigation. Can we timeline?
samira: If canary looks good, can roll full in ~45–60 minutes. I'll notify customer: initial mitigation in 10–15 minutes (canary), full rollout if green.
maya_r: Postmortem action items: - add a safety cap: if p99 > 3s and avg_batch_size < 2, automatically reduce hold_window_ms by factor 10 for that pool; - improve client-id routing so mobile bursts get different batching profile.
alex.k: I'll file infra task and attach experiment results. For now applying canary.
loadbot: :thumbsup: patch queued to 10% canary. Monitoring alerts updated to watch cb-debug-traces for regression.
support_jordan: Thanks team — I'll update customer with the plan and keep this thread until resolved.
eng-sre-oncall: Noted. Will post results from canary in ~12m.
